author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: Repeated readings from the gauge no longer skew the usage rate or refill detection. A newly added tank gets its device without re-saving the app. The tile turns red at your low-fuel setting, and API calls time out instead of hanging. New healthStatus attribute on each tank (offline when the API is failing or the tank hasn't reported for 96 hours); outages are logged once, with an hourly reminder and a recovery line. After updating, open the app and click Done. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
